verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own Filters & Rules feature. Community reports confirm users build filters that act on incoming mail, and note that filters do not apply to existing emails, which shows they trigger on arrival. The evidence is only a docs page title plus anecdotes, so the range of triggers, conditions and actions is unproven. Missing for 10: documented rule conditions and action types, triggers beyond mail delivery (e.g., calendar or other events), and programmatic or API-based rule management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Fastmail filters don't apply to existing emails
